WHY FLYINGDAWG AERIALS




## THE AERIAL ADVANTAGEWORKING AT ALTITUDE


Our drone photography services give developers, contractors, inspectors, roofers, and solar professionals a smarter, safer, and faster way to document, evaluate, and present their projects — without ever leaving the ground.











### SAFER VANTAGE POINTS


Eliminate the need for ladders, scaffolding, or confined-space entry. Our drones access rooftops, towers, and hard-to-reach structures safely — protecting your crew and your liability.











### FASTER SITE DOCUMENTATION


Cover entire properties and job sites in a fraction of the time. High-resolution aerial captures replace hours of ground-level walkthroughs — accelerating inspections, progress reports, and real estate drone photography deliverables.











### PREMIUM PRESENTATION QUALITY


Cinematic 4K footage and high-resolution stills that command attention in listings, proposals, and pitch decks. Sharper imagery drives faster decisions for developers, solar installers, and commercial contractors alike.











### CLEARER DECISION-MAKING


Bird's-eye context reveals site conditions, boundary lines, and structural details that ground-level views miss entirely. Give stakeholders the full picture — literally — before committing resources.

DRONE PHOTOGRAPHY SERVICES


## WHAT WE DELIVER


Professional aerial drone photography services engineered for precision, clarity, and commercial impact — from ground level to altitude.















01

### Real Estate Marketing


Elevate property listings with commanding aerial perspectives that showcase scale, surroundings, and curb appeal — giving buyers a complete picture before they step through the door.


- High-resolution exterior & property boundary shots

- Neighborhood context & proximity flyovers

- Twilight & golden-hour listing imagery














02

### Construction Progress Capture


Document every phase of your build with scheduled aerial documentation that keeps stakeholders informed, tracks milestones, and creates a comprehensive visual record from groundbreak to completion.


- Scheduled milestone flyovers & time-lapse sequences

- Site-wide orthographic mapping & overview shots

- Stakeholder-ready progress reports with imagery














03

### Inspection & Assessment Imaging


Access hard-to-reach structures safely and efficiently. Our drones capture high-definition close-proximity imagery of towers, bridges, and industrial assets — eliminating the need for scaffolding or rope access.


- Close-range structural & surface defect documentation

- Safe access to towers, chimneys & elevated assets

- Annotated image reports for engineering teams














04

### Roofing & Solar Views


Get a complete overhead picture of any roof or solar installation without the risk of manual access. Ideal for insurance assessments, pre-purchase evaluations, and solar panel performance reviews.


- Nadir (straight-down) & oblique roof surface capture

- Solar panel layout mapping & condition imaging

- Insurance-grade documentation & timestamped files

























HOW WE FLY

## FROM BRIEF TO BREATHTAKING


Our drone photography services follow a disciplined four-stage flight path — engineered for precision, built for stunning results every time.


















01






### PROJECT BRIEF


We start by understanding your vision, goals, and deliverables. Whether it's real estate drone photography, a commercial production, or an event capture — we lock in objectives before a single rotor spins.











02






### FLIGHT PLANNING


Our pilots chart the airspace, assess weather windows, secure necessary permits, and map every flight path. Precision pre-mission planning ensures zero surprises and maximum coverage on shoot day.











03






### CAPTURE DAY


Rotors up. Our FAA-certified pilots deploy professional-grade drones to capture cinematic aerial footage and high-resolution stills. We execute the flight plan with technical discipline and creative instinct.











04






### FINAL DELIVERY


Fully edited, color-graded, and delivery-ready visuals arrive in your hands on schedule. Photos and video files are packaged to your exact format specs — ready to publish, broadcast, or present.

# Born to Fly.Built to Deliver.




Flyingdawg Aerials launched from a simple conviction: the world looks better from above. From towering real estate developments to sweeping cinematic productions, our aerial perspective transforms ordinary projects into extraordinary visuals. We don't just operate drones — we command the sky with precision, creativity, and an identity that is unmistakably Flyingdawg.

Our Mission



## Built on Three Unbreakable Principles


Every drone photography services flight we conduct is guided by a disciplined commitment to the work — not just capturing footage, but delivering visuals that inform decisions, tell stories, and move projects forward. These three principles define how we operate at Flyingdawg Aerials.











01

### Precision



We plan every flight with surgical attention to altitude, angle, and framing. For real estate drone photography services and commercial clients alike, imprecise imagery costs time and money. Our pre-flight mapping and calibrated flight paths ensure every frame captures exactly what your project demands — no guesswork, no reshoot.


- Pre-flight route mapping

- Calibrated altitude control

- Frame-perfect composition









02

### Safety



FAA-compliant operations are not a checkbox for us — they are the foundation of every job. We conduct full site risk assessments, maintain comprehensive liability coverage, and operate only certified aircraft. Your property, your crew, and the surrounding environment are always protected under our watch.


- FAA Part 107 certified pilots

- Full liability coverage

- On-site risk assessment









03

### Impact



Stunning footage only creates value when it communicates clearly. We deliver polished, color-graded imagery and cinematic video sequences that elevate marketing materials, accelerate property sales, and give stakeholders the aerial documentation they need to make confident decisions — on deadline, every time.


- Professional color grading

- Fast turnaround delivery

- Broadcast-ready output


























GEAR & CAPABILITY


## PROFESSIONAL DRONEEQUIPMENT & WORKFLOW


Every mission starts with the right tools. Our professional-grade drone fleet and disciplined operational workflow ensure that every aerial photography and videography assignment is executed with precision, stability, and cinematic confidence.
















### 4K STABILIZED IMAGING


Cinema-grade 4K sensors paired with 3-axis mechanical gimbal stabilization eliminate vibration and wind drift, delivering buttery-smooth footage and razor-sharp stills on every flight.










### EXTENDED FLIGHT RANGE


High-capacity intelligent battery systems and dual-redundant signal links provide extended operational range, keeping our drones responsive and reliable across large sites and complex environments.










### FULL-SITE MAPPING ACCURACY


GPS-assisted autonomous waypoint missions and real-time telemetry data allow complete site documentation with consistent altitude, overlap, and coverage — ideal for real estate drone photography and large-scale surveys.










### PROFESSIONAL WORKFLOW DISCIPLINE


Pre-flight checklists, airspace authorization, and structured post-production pipelines ensure every project is delivered on schedule with broadcast-ready quality and zero surprises.










### FAA CERTIFIED OPERATIONS


All pilots hold current FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificates. We carry full commercial liability insurance and operate in strict compliance with national airspace regulations on every drone photography services engagement.

NEED ANSWERS?

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS


Everything you need to know before booking your drone photography services shoot — answered clearly and directly.






Q


### What types of projects do you cover?


We handle a wide range of aerial projects including real estate drone photography services, commercial property showcases, construction progress documentation, event coverage, film and video production, landscape and environmental surveys, and industrial inspections. If it benefits from a bird's-eye perspective, we can capture it.





Q


### How long does it take to receive my footage?


Standard turnaround for edited photos is 48–72 hours after the shoot. Video projects typically deliver within 5–7 business days depending on complexity and length. Rush delivery options are available — just let us know your deadline when booking.





Q


### What happens if the weather is bad on shoot day?


Safety and image quality are our top priorities. If conditions include high winds, rain, fog, or restricted visibility, we will reschedule at no additional charge. We monitor forecasts closely and communicate early so your timeline is never left in limbo. Most rescheduled shoots happen within 48 hours.





Q


### Do you handle FAA permits and airspace clearances?


Yes. All of our pilots are FAA Part 107 certified and we manage all necessary airspace authorizations, LAANC approvals, and site-specific waivers. You do not need to worry about compliance — we take care of the regulatory side so you can focus on the results.





Q


### What should I prepare before the shoot?


Clear the site of vehicles, clutter, or debris that could distract from the shot. If it's a property shoot, ensure lawns are mowed and staging is complete. Share any specific angles, boundaries, or restricted zones with us beforehand. We'll send a pre-shoot checklist once your booking is confirmed.





Q


### What areas do you service?


We operate across the region and are available for travel to project sites outside our local area. Travel fees may apply for shoots beyond a standard radius. Contact us with your location and we'll confirm availability and any additional logistics.





Q


### What file formats will I receive?


Photos are delivered as high-resolution JPEGs (and RAW files upon request). Video is delivered in MP4 format at 4K resolution unless otherwise specified. All files are shared via a private download link within the agreed delivery window.





Q


### How do I book a shoot?


Simply reach out through our contact form or give us a call. We'll discuss your project goals, site details, and timeline, then send you a quote within one business day. A deposit confirms your booking and locks in your preferred date.








Still have questions? We're ready to talk through your project.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  5/31/2026



Flyingdawg Aerials ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Flyingdawg Aerials

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  May 31, 2026



Flyingdawg Aerials is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Flyingdawg Aerials

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

# Terms of Use



Last updated:  May 31, 2026



Use of this site constitutes agreement to the terms outlined below. Please read carefully before use.

- Use of the site for lawful purposes only
